marie: heads-up: support ticket #8421 shows customer 'AcmeRetail' hitting errors on embeddings calls

sophia: ```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",region="eu",status=~"5.."}[2m])) by (status)
```

eng-sre: reassigning dedicated pool throttle to relieve burst, doing a graceful restart of worker-quant-03

sophia: adding an alert to track customer error rate by tenant: `error_rate_by_tenant` dashboard updated

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by ajay

ajay: update: after restart error rate down from 18% -> 4% in 3m. keeping onbridge for 15m for observation :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marie: thanks team, I'll update affected customers and escalate to account execs where needed

ajay: will handoff to sophia in 15m if stable. tagging @sophia for takeover
